quizzes.question: A Hancho's job is mainly to…
options: Fill in the shift report at the end of the day
Lead at the gemba: keep the standard, react to gaps, develop people
Do the hardest station personally, every shift
quizzes.explanation: A Hancho leads where the value is made: protecting the standard, responding to abnormalities fast and building the team's capability. Reports and covering stations aren't the core of the role.

quizzes.question: The hourly board turns red and suspect units may have a safety risk. Which response level?
options: Level 1: the team fixes it quietly
Level 2: call maintenance when they're free
Level 3: contain and escalate to management immediately
quizzes.explanation: Safety or customer risk is level 3: contain the units and escalate immediately. Don't wait to see if the team can handle it.
